glossario.h1: Glossary of quotes and home works
glossario.intro: The words you find in quotes, contracts and paperwork for home works, explained in a few lines. Where a term has a legal definition, we give it with the article it comes from, so you can go and check.

termini.definizione: A pricing method where the price covers the job as a whole, as described in the quote: if the quantities turn out higher than expected, the price does not change. The risk on the measurements is with whoever does the work. See the guide on [lump sum or measured](/guide/preventivo-a-corpo-o-a-misura).

A pricing method where the quote sets unit prices (per square metre, per metre, per item) and the total is worked out on the quantities actually done, measured at the end of the job or at each progress stage.

The act by which the customer accepts the quote. Under the codice civile (Civil Code) the contract is concluded when the person who made the offer learns of the acceptance, and an acceptance that changes the offer counts as a new offer (art. 1326).

A sum paid in advance against the price, which is deducted from the total. It does not have the effects of a caparra (deposit with penalty effect), and in jobs paid in instalments, paying simple advances does not mean the work is presumed accepted (art. 1666).

The contract by which one party undertakes, organising the necessary means and running the job at their own risk, to carry out a work or a service for a payment in money (art. 1655 of the codice civile, the Civil Code). It is the typical form of an accepted quote for home works.

The bricklaying work needed for another trade's job: opening and closing chases, drilling holes, setting boxes and junction boxes into the wall for the systems. The quote should say whether it is included or whether another firm does it.

The goods listed in the ministerial decree of 29 December 1999: lifts and hoists, external and internal windows and doors, boilers, video entry phones, air conditioning and air recirculation equipment, bathroom sanitaryware and taps, security systems. In home maintenance work they get IVA at 10% only up to the value of the rest of the work, and the excess is at 22%. See the guide on [IVA on home works](/guide/iva-preventivo-lavori-casa).

The bank transfer with the payment reference required for tax deductions, which shows the tax code of the person claiming the deduction and the VAT number or tax code of the person receiving the payment. On these payments the bank or the Post Office withholds a ritenuta d'acconto (withholding tax) from the person receiving the payment.

A sum given when the contract is concluded. If the job goes ahead, it is deducted from the price; if the person who gave it fails to perform, the other party can withdraw and keep it; if the person who received it fails to perform, the other party can withdraw and ask for double (art. 1385).

Comunicazione di inizio lavori asseverata (certified notification of start of works, art. 6-bis of the testo unico dell'edilizia, the consolidated building act). It is needed for works that are not free building work and do not require a SCIA (certified notice of start of activity) or a permesso di costruire (building permit), such as many extraordinary maintenance jobs without structural work. A qualified technician certifies it.
The person who commissions the work and pays for it. For site safety rules, it is the person on whose behalf the work is carried out (art. 89 of legislative decree 81 of 2008).
The list of the works in a project, with measured quantities and unit prices, which gives the estimated cost of the job. It is typical of jobs designed by a technician and of public contracts.

Under the codice del consumo (Consumer Code), the individual who acts for purposes outside their business, trade, craft or profession (art. 3). This is the customer who has the right to withdraw in contracts made away from business premises or at a distance.

A contract with a consumer concluded without the parties being physically present at the same time, using only means of distance communication, within an organised system of distance selling or service provision (art. 45 of the codice del consumo, the Consumer Code).

The contract by which a person undertakes to carry out a work or a service for a payment, mainly with their own labour and with no employment relationship (art. 2222 of the codice civile, the Civil Code). It is typical of the craftsperson who works alone; for defects, the time limits are eight days to report them and one year to take action (art. 2226).

A contract with a consumer concluded with the parties physically present at the same time in a place other than the trader's premises, for example at the customer's home (art. 45 of the codice del consumo, the Consumer Code). The customer usually has the right to withdraw.

The document that the installing firm issues at the end of work on a system, required by ministerial decree 37 of 2008 (DM 37/2008), with attachments such as the report on the materials used and the design or diagram of the system.

The document that replaces the dichiarazione di conformità (declaration of conformity) for systems built before 27 March 2008, when that was never produced or can no longer be found. After a site inspection, it is issued by a professional registered on the professional roll with at least five years of experience in the field or, for systems below the design thresholds, by someone who has been technical manager of a licensed firm for at least five years (art. 7, paragraph 6, of ministerial decree 37 of 2008).

Defects in the work compared with what was agreed or with good workmanship. In an appalto (contract for works) the customer must report them within sixty days of discovering them and the claim lapses two years after delivery; the guarantee is not due if they accepted the work and the defects were known or easy to spot (art. 1667 of the codice civile, the Italian Civil Code). For serious defects in a building the contractor is liable for ten years (art. 1669), including in renovations.

Works that are carried out without a building permit or notification, including ordinary maintenance (art. 6 of the testo unico dell'edilizia, the consolidated building act). Other sector rules still have to be followed, for example those on systems and on safety.

The list of what the quote does not cover: work by other trades, building permits and paperwork, waste disposal, materials supplied by the customer. As far as the customer is concerned, anything not excluded is included, so always write the exclusions down.
A line item that covers both the material and the labour to fit it. It is different from labour only ("sola posa"), which you use when the customer buys the material.

Work paid by the time actually spent, with an hourly rate for each worker, plus the materials used. You use it when you can't know in advance how much work will be needed, like fault finding or small jobs.

The IVA (Italian VAT) mechanism, also called reverse charge, where the invoice is issued without tax and the customer accounts for the IVA. In building work it covers subcontracts between firms in the sector and cleaning, demolition, plant installation and building completion services supplied to IVA-registered customers (art. 17, paragraph 6, of the IVA decree). It does not apply to private customers.

The reduced rates for certain building work: 10% for ordinary and extraordinary maintenance of homes and for restoration, renovation and refurbishment, 4% for contracted construction of a first home that is not a luxury property. They depend on the type of property, the type of work and who buys the materials.

The tradesperson's list of unit prices for the jobs and materials they use most often, each with its unit of measure. It is the starting point for the lines of the quote: see the [price list](/funzioni/listino-prezzi).

Work to repair, renew and replace the finishes of buildings, and work needed to keep existing systems running properly (art. 3 of the testo unico dell'edilizia, the Italian consolidated building act). It falls under "edilizia libera" (work that needs no permit).

Work to renew and replace parts of buildings, including structural ones, and to build or add sanitary and technical services, without changing the overall volume or the intended use (art. 3 of the testo unico dell'edilizia, the Italian consolidated building act). On homes it normally carries IVA at 10%.

The standard form set out in annex I of the codice del consumo (the Italian consumer code), which the trader must give the consumer together with the information on withdrawal in contracts made away from business premises and at a distance. The customer can use it or withdraw with any other clear statement.

The costs of the measures for working safely on site: temporary works, collective protection, earthing systems, coordination measures. When there is a safety and coordination plan, they are estimated there and cannot be discounted in bids (annex XV of decreto legislativo 81 del 2008, the Italian workplace safety decree).

Piano operativo di sicurezza (operational safety plan): the document the employer of the contracting firm writes for each site (art. 89 of decreto legislativo 81 del 2008, the Italian workplace safety decree).

A list of reference prices for building work. Regional price lists are drawn up by the regions, are valid for one year and are mainly used for public contracts; in private work they can be a point of comparison, but the price is set by whoever writes the quote.

In a works contract the client can withdraw even after work has started, as long as they cover the contractor for the costs incurred, the work done and the lost profit (art. 1671 of the codice civile, the Italian civil code).

The right of a private customer (a consumer) to withdraw from a contract without giving any reason, when the contract was signed away from business premises or at a distance: 14 days, or 30 if the contract came from an unsolicited visit (art. 52 of the codice del consumo, the Italian consumer code). For services, the period starts from the moment the contract is concluded. If the contract also includes goods, it starts from the day the consumer receives them. See the guide on [withdrawing from a quote accepted at home](/guide/recesso-preventivo-accettato-a-casa).

Work that keeps the building in good condition and ensures it works properly, respecting its original type, form and structure (art. 3 of the testo unico dell'edilizia, the Italian consolidated building act). For IVA it carries 10% without the "beni significativi" calculation (significant goods, a special IVA rule on certain materials).

The price change provided for by the codice civile (the Italian civil code) when, because of unforeseeable circumstances, the cost of materials or labour changes by more than one tenth of the total price: only the part above the tenth is reviewed (art. 1664). The parties can exclude it in the contract.

Work that transforms a building through a systematic set of operations, which can result in a building that is wholly or partly different from the previous one (art. 3 of the testo unico dell'edilizia, the Italian consolidated building act). Renovation contracts carry IVA at 10%.

Stato di avanzamento lavori (progress statement): the measure, at a given date, of the work done, on which you ask for a part payment. For work done in instalments, the codice civile (the Italian civil code) allows you to ask for payment in proportion to the work done (art. 1666).

The last payment, which closes the account. Unless agreed otherwise or customary practice says differently, the contractor is entitled to payment when the client accepts the work (art. 1665 of the codice civile, the Italian civil code).

Segnalazione certificata di inizio attività (certified notice of start of work, art. 22 of the testo unico dell'edilizia, the Italian consolidated building act). Among other things, it is needed for extraordinary maintenance involving structural parts or facades, for restoration of structural parts and for building renovation that does not need a building permit.

Taking waste materials, such as rubble, old sanitaryware and packaging, to an authorised facility. In the quote, write whether it is included, who loads and carries it, and whether the facility's charges are extra.
When whoever won the contract hands part of the work to another firm. The contractor cannot subcontract unless the client has authorised it (art. 1656 of the codice civile, the Italian civil code).

Any medium that lets you keep the information received for an adequate period and reproduce it unchanged (art. 45 of the codice del consumo, the Italian consumer code). In contracts made away from business premises, the information on withdrawal must be given on paper or, if the customer agrees, on another durable medium.

The period during which the quote stays valid. If you have committed to keeping your offer open for a certain time, withdrawing it during that period has no effect (art. 1329 of the codice civile, the Italian civil code).

Changes to the work compared with what was agreed. The client must authorise them and the authorisation has to be proved in writing (art. 1659); the client can order changes up to one sixth of the total price, paying for the extra work even if the price was a lump sum (art. 1661).

meta.descrizione: PreventivoLampo is made by K Digital Solution, Sofiane Khatib's studio. Why it exists, how we treat your prices and your customers' data, how to contact us.

chiSiamo.intro: PreventivoLampo is a service from K Digital Solution, Sofiane Khatib's studio that builds software for small businesses. It started from something every tradesperson knows: the work on site finishes at six, and the quotes get written in the evening.

sezioni.titolo: Why it exists
paragrafi: If you work in people's homes, you do the site visit, take the measurements and drive back in the van with it all in your head. Then the quote sits there for days, because writing it means looking up prices, redoing the metre counts, remembering what's excluded. Meanwhile the customer asks someone else.
PreventivoLampo is there to close that gap: you describe the job right after the site visit, as you would to a colleague, and the draft is ready before you get to your next site.

sezioni.titolo: The rules we set ourselves
paragrafi: They're the same ones you'll find on every page of the site, because they are the product.

punti.testo: Every price in the draft comes from your price list. If an item isn't there, it's left to be priced: the system doesn't make up figures.
Nothing reaches the customer without your approval. If measurements are missing, it asks you instead of guessing.
If you get stuck, write to us and you'll hear back from the person who built the service, not a bot.

Your price list and quotes are stored in the European Union. To prepare the draft, the text of your site visit goes through an external provider, named on the Privacy page. We sign a data processing agreement with you for your customers' data.

sezioni.titolo: The pilot programme
paragrafi: The pilot programme is for a group of tradespeople from different trades. They use it on their real jobs for 30 days and tell us what doesn't work. What we learn from the pilot changes the product, and the figures we publish will come from there, measured.

chiSiamo.contatti: Write to us at [{email}](mailto:{email}). We'll answer ourselves.
